headline: Atomos Brand Monitoring Report for 2026-10-17

coverage.summary: DPReview articles discussing firmware updates and compatibility issues related to Atomos products.

visibility_gaps: GPT retail/product sources are treated as unverified leads, not new verified social mentions.
methodology: Conducted a comprehensive search for Atomos-related content on Reddit, YouTube, DPReview, Blackmagic, RED, Sony camera forums, and videography discussions, focusing on user feedback, product compatibility, and demonstrations. Prioritized sources with explicit mentions of Atomos products and camera/recording contexts, ensuring all findings are dated precisely 2026-10-17.
